bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Conceal
bridge_functions.description: Protect the window from capture while a screen holding a credential, a session token or pairing material is up

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Reveal
bridge_functions.description: Stop protecting for that screen. A backgrounded application is still protected

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.IsProtected
bridge_functions.description: Whether the window is protected from capture right now

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.Authenticate
bridge_functions.description: Ask the device who this is, falling back to the passcode where biometry fails rather than to unlocked

bridge_functions.name: Lemonfiber.CanAuthenticate
bridge_functions.description: Whether the device has a screen lock configured and can authenticate at all

info_plist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: lemonfiber talks to your stack on your own network. It does not send anything anywhere else.
